helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Methoxyacetylfentanyl, commonly known as MAF is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

pharmacology.en: It is a strong agonist of the mu opioid receptor, the same target as morphine and fentanyl, which brings pain relief and euphoria but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它是 μ 型鴉片受體的強效致效劑，與嗎啡、吩坦尼作用於相同標靶，能帶來止痛與欣快感，但也會使呼吸減慢。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是 μ 型鸦片受体的强效致效剂，与吗啡、吩坦尼作用于相同标靶，能带来止痛与欣快感，但也会使呼吸减慢。

fact.en: Methoxyacetylfentanyl is fentanyl with a methoxy group on the end of its acyl chain, the same piece found in ocfentanil, which also carries a fluorine atom.
fact.zh: Methoxyacetylfentanyl 是在吩坦尼醯基鏈的末端加一個甲氧基，與 ocfentanil 擁有相同的部分，只是 ocfentanil 還多一個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: Methoxyacetylfentanyl 是在吩坦尼酰基链的末端加一个甲氧基，与 ocfentanil 拥有相同的部分，只是 ocfentanil 还多一个氟原子。
